customer_message.subject: Termination of my lease at Feldstrasse 58, Zürich
customer_message.body: Hi, thanks for taking this. I received a written notice of termination from Privera Wohnen AG for my flat at Feldstrasse 58 in Zürich, a 4.5-room flat. My wife lives here with me too, so it is our family home. A few weeks before the notice, I complained in writing about mould and a broken heating valve in the bathroom, and I also challenged the rent they charged me. Now they are terminating, and I honestly think this is payback for asserting my rights. The letter itself does not state a clear reason. In a phone call last month, the property manager mentioned late payments from my side. I am not sure whether that is actually the reason for the termination, or just something they said during the call. Nobody has told me that in writing, and I do not know what they would base it on. Can you tell me what I can do to challenge this termination, and what deadlines I need to watch? I have the notice here and can send you a copy. Thanks, Casey
